title: Pathologic fractures due to any cause
summary: Three pathologic fractures within a 12-month period from a disorder weakening bone (osteoporosis, osteogenesis imperfecta, etc.), with limitation requiring assistive device or producing inability to use upper extremities.

children.criterion: Three pathologic fractures occurring on separate, distinct occasions within any 12-month period
Underlying disorder that weakens bone (osteoporosis, osteogenesis imperfecta, skeletal dysplasia, medication side effect, endocrine disorder)
Documented assistive device need OR upper extremity inability
Documented medical need for walker, bilateral canes, bilateral crutches, or two-handed wheeled mobility device
Inability to use one upper extremity for fine and gross movements; needs one-handed assistive device requiring the other upper extremity
Inability to use either upper extremity for fine and gross movements
